thread:
incident-bot: PAGER - Priority 2: EnterpriseX (dedicated VPC) reporting missing trace spans and sourceless logs for a subset of tenants. Paging on-call: @sara_oncall. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-obsv-gap

sara_oncall: ack, I'm on it. Saw the alert come through. Can someone confirm which collectors/forwarders are in the path for EnterpriseX?

miguel_infra: EnterpriseX uses env-vpc-prod -> forwarder-fleet-3 -> obsv-proxy (tenant-isolation mode enabled) -> splunk-forwarder. Recent deploy to forwarder-fleet-3 3 hours ago.

emi_oncall: I'm joining. Customer impact: EnterpriseX support reported failed span correlation for ~20% of requests (missing tenant_id tag), causing trace stitching to drop. Metrics show p95 latency OK; primarily visibility loss.

ron_product: Customer says they can see logs but many spans are "source": null in traces UI. They can't map requests to tenant shards for debugging. Impact: inability to trace errors and measure SLA for affected tenants.

obs-bot: Observability alert: span-drop-rate (enterpriseX) increased from 0.2% -> 22% at 3167998000. Top tag missing: tenant_id. Sample trace ids: trace-9af1, trace-bc33, trace-4e7d.

sara_oncall: thanks. Miguel, can we pull a sample of raw spans coming off forwarder-fleet-3 for tenant shard 42? Either run query or grab a pcap/ingest sample.

miguel_infra: grabbing sample now. Running: ```curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $FORWARDER_API" 'https://forwarder-3.internal/api/v1/spans?tenant=42&limit=100' | jq '.' > /tmp/entx_spans.json```

miguel_infra: sample shows entries with missing source attribute and tenant_id appears in payload under headers sometimes but not promoted to span tags. Looks like a tag-extraction transform did not run on ~1/5 of events.

emi_oncall: transform pipeline has a feature flag that gated extraction for large payloads; we rolled a change in last forwarder deploy. Could be that the new path bypasses legacy extractor when content-length > 256KB.

ron_product: EnterpriseX has a few heavy requests with large metadata; that would explain the size threshold. But why only for some tenants? They route through different forwarder instances based on capacity; maybe some instances have config drift.

incident-bot: TODO created: INC-2026-ENTX-OBS. Assigned to miguel_infra.

sara_oncall: Miguel, check forwarder-fleet-3 instance configs and flag status. If we can toggle the extract flag to force-run on the instance for affected tenants, do that as mitigation.

miguel_infra: Found two instances (fwd-3a, fwd-3c) where feature-flag extractor=false. Others are true. Investigating deployment diff.

emi_oncall: Rolling a temporary override to true for those instances. Command: ```kubectl -n forwarders set env deployment/fwd-3a EXTRACT_TENANT_TAG=true && kubectl -n forwarders rollout restart deployment/fwd-3a``` Doing fwd-3a then fwd-3c. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/fwd-3a (replicas 4) at 3168005400.

miguel_infra: fwd-3a back up, extractor=true. Sampling spans now. Early check: new spans show tenant_id promoted correctly.

ron_product: pinged EnterpriseX support channel with update and asked them to validate trace visibility for their affected tenant ids (examples: tenant-42, tenant-128).

EnterpriseX-Support (external): Confirmed improvement for tenant-42. Still seeing gaps for tenant-128.

emi_oncall: fwd-3c still rolling; I suspect it has a stale image tag causing the flag not to be present. Checking image digests.

miguel_infra: fwd-3c had an older image (sha:abc123) deployed by a canary earlier. Pulling the current image (sha:def456) and restarting.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for deployment/fwd-3c at 3168009000.

obs-bot: Post-mitigation metrics: span-drop-rate reduced to 1.8% for EnterpriseX at 3168009800. Correlation with extractor=true.

emi_oncall: Good. For customers behind dedicated VPCs we should be careful: the feature flag is turned on cluster-wide by default but some customer-dedicated forwarders had drift. We'll run a reconciliation job.

sara_oncall: Can we patch a short-term diagnostic that tags spans with forwarder-instance id for troubleshooting? Would help root cause if we see future drift.

miguel_infra: Added a diagnostic header "x-forwarder-id" to span meta for a 2-hour window. Rolling to forwarders. ```kubectl -n forwarders set env deployment/fwd-3a DIAG_TAG_FORWARDER=true```

ron_product: Notifying account team to expect brief metadata addition. No privacy issues, only instance id. @ron_product will send note.

ron_product: Sent message to EnterpriseX AM: "We're seeing config drift in forwarder instances causing tenant tag extraction to skip on some large payloads. We've patched the instances and enabled a diagnostic tag. We'll follow up with root cause and long-term fix."

EnterpriseX-Support (external): Appreciate the speedy response. Please advise on long-term prevention.

emi_oncall: Long-term: reconcile forwarder images on a daily job, add config drift alarms that detect varying values of EXTRACT_TENANT_TAG across a fleet for a given customer, and add unit tests around the extractor path for large payloads.

incident-bot: Timeline updated: INC-2026-ENTX-OBS: 3167998000 (alert) -> 3168001234 (page) -> 3168005400 (mitigation start) -> 3168009800 (mitigation verified).

sara_oncall: Closing P2 impact: customer-facing visibility restored for most tenants. Leaving the incident open for RCA and cross-team follow-up. Next steps: 1) RCA doc (miguel_infra) 2) Reconciliation job (eng-sre) 3) Postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT (invite created).

miguel_infra: I'll drop an RCA stub here and attach logs + diffs. Quick note: root cause appears to be an older canary image that lacked the size-gated extractor override, plus a mistaken feature-flag rollout order.

obs-bot: Saved sample traces and span dumps to /artifacts/INC-2026-ENTX-OBS/ for postmortem.

emi_oncall: Any objections to un-flagging the temporary diagnostic after 2 hours? We should keep it only long enough for audit.

sara_oncall: fine. Set timer.

sara_oncall: Thank you everyone. Great coordination. :clap:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned follow-ups: RCA (miguel_infra), fleet-reconcile (emi_oncall), runbook-update (sara_oncall).
